{{Top|leg}}
'''Duplicate''' was a [[Ta-Ree]] spell capable of being wielded by [[Ascendant (Kathol)|Ascendants]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. Ascendants using this spell created an illusionary mirror image of the caster. The illusion seemed real to whomever interacted with it. The caster could experience whatever the duplicate did through a full range of normal senses. The illusion appears to have form and substance, and registered as a normal being to [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]].

Duplicate was one of the most difficult Ta-Ree spells to learn, and required knowledge of number of other spells including [[block pain]], [[boost senses]], [[cloak presence]], [[detect life]], [[detect Ta-Ree]], [[lessen another's pain]], [[psychokinesis]], [[projective empathy]], [[receptive empathy]], and [[sense life]].
